subject: Linguistics
title: Meaning in the Age of AI
description: A 60-second lesson on Meaning in the Age of AI.

hook.text: Large language models produce fluent text—but do they understand what their words mean?

buildup.text: LLMs learn word associations from vast data without ever experiencing the real world.

discovery.text: They capture distributional meaning—words that appear in similar contexts have similar vectors.

twist.text: Critics argue this is pattern matching, not understanding—no grounding in actual experience.

climax.text: The debate echoes centuries of philosophical arguments about what 'meaning' really requires.

punchline.text: Machines process meaning—whether they have it is the open question.

quiz.question: What kind of meaning do LLMs capture?
